articles.description: BBC's Blue Planet III is looking to prove its authenticity by leaving in the less-than-perfect shots. articles.title: Pennsylvania will require labels on AI-generated ads
articles.description: On Thursday, Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro signed the Artificial Intelligence Deceptive Advertising Act into law, requiring disclosures on AI-generated ads.
